# Skill: notebook-builder

## When Active
Triggered when generating, editing, or debugging Colab notebooks.

## Notebook Structure (generated by `tools/generate_notebook.py`)
1. **Title cell** (markdown) — recipe name + description
2. **Install cell** (code) — `!pip install -q <deps>`
3. **%%writefile cells** (code) — one per source file in manifest
4. **Run cell** (code) — `!<run_command>`

## Manifest Format (`notebook_manifest.yaml`)
```yaml
title: "My Recipe Notebook"
install:
  - package1
  - package2>=1.0
files:
  - src: main.py
    dst: main.py
    description: "Main entry point"
run: "python main.py --flag"
```

## Commands
```bash
uv run python tools/generate_notebook.py <recipe-name>
# Output: outputs/notebooks/<recipe-name>.ipynb
```

## Rules
- Update `notebook_manifest.yaml` before regenerating.
- Every source file listed in `files:` must exist under the recipe directory.
- The `run:` command should match `run.sh` logic.
